head_commit.message:
Merge current Lake source metadata into the validated parade repair

Retain exact current stamped history and both raw documentation appends.
Record the actual published 1835 Stage 3 readings: desktop and phone each
passed 107 checks. The renderer, fixture, registration and native isolation
measurement remain byte-exact the actually executed 05366ebe source.

The later Lake increment changes documentary notes and one source edge,
not geometry, placement, phase, function value/confidence or native yard
items. All old citations, source edges and names remain value-exact; the
only selected runtime source intersection is the release-note file, read
by smoke part 13 rather than executed part 3. Preserve the explicit tested
head and field-consumer carry proof instead of claiming new browser runs.

All four scoped runtime legs properly closed green on 05366ebe with exact
source/Git/publication/helper guards; root directly reviewed eight card
images with their clipping limits. Seven fresh merged owner checks pass
without tracked drift. Final hosted eight-part gate remains required.
Roof body acceptance and original T-3041/T-2387 image acceptance stay open.
